zone_fill_policy: All zones refilled with KiCad 10.0.7. Filled copper polygons are not claimed identical outside the edits; outlines/settings retained. See independent review for old-cache versus fresh-fill comparison.
limits: Geometry/centreline lengths only. SVG omits filled planes for clarity. Local FB route on B.Cu is separated from top SW copper by internal planes. DRC and schematic parity are separate checks; stability/EMI/hardware validation still required. Before BOOT count uses copper sum plus the 1.65 mm resistor pad span; excludes via barrel lengths and includes sub-micron duplicate old segments.
